response.sql: WITH member_by_dept AS (SELECT ma.department, COUNT(m.member_id) as member_count FROM member m JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.department), total_members AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM member_by_dept), shares AS (SELECT d.department, d.member_count, CAST(d.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total as share FROM member_by_dept d CROSS JOIN total_members t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share as share_minus_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
